name: Convoca
tagline: Offsites that people actually remember for the right reasons.
positioning: Convoca helps small teams and independent organizers plan real offsites — venue, agenda, travel, and budget — from one calm workspace.

hero.h1: Plan the offsite. Skip the 40-tab spreadsheet.
hero.sub: Convoca turns venue hunting, travel logistics, and agenda building into one shared plan — so your team retreat feels intentional instead of improvised.

features.title: One plan, not twelve threads
features.description: Venue, rooming, sessions, and budget live in a single itinerary everyone can read. No more forwarding the latest version of the doc.

features.title: Venue shortlist in an afternoon
features.description: Compare spaces by headcount, distance, and total cost. Convoca flags the ones that blow your per-person budget before you inquire.

features.title: Agenda that respects attention
features.description: Drag sessions onto a timeline with breaks built in. Everyone sees the day at a glance, from the 9am kickoff to the closing dinner.

features.title: Budget you can defend
features.description: Every line — flights, meals, facilitator — rolls up to a real number and a per-head figure you can send to whoever signs off.

features.title: Travel without the reply-all
features.description: Collect arrival times and dietary notes once. Convoca assembles the roster so nobody lands with no ride and no room.

features.title: Reuse what worked
features.description: Save last quarter's retreat as a template. Adjust the dates, swap the venue, and you're 80% done before lunch.

testimonials.quote: I organize two retreats a year for our little studio. Convoca cut my planning from three frantic weeks to about four evenings. The budget rollup alone paid for itself.
testimonials.name: Marisol Ventura

testimonials.quote: We used to lose the best venue because someone forgot to reply. Now the shortlist and the deadlines sit in one place. Our last offsite actually started on time.
testimonials.name: Declan Ruiz

testimonials.quote: The agenda timeline made our team stop cramming sessions back to back. People came home rested instead of wrecked. That's the whole point of a retreat.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

pricing.blurb: For planning your first offsite without the spreadsheet chaos.
For people who run retreats more than once a year.
For small teams planning offsites for multiple groups.

homepage.footerBlurb: Convoca is a calm workspace for planning corporate offsites — built for the organizer who actually cares whether people come home glad they went.
